chunks: Ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurārah, who said:

A man came to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام while he was behind the Maqām, and said: “I have combined hajj and ʿumrah.” He said to him, “Have you performed tawaf of the House?” He said, “Yes.” He said, “Have you driven the hady?” He said, “No.” Then Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام took hold of his hair, then said, “You have exited iḥrām, by Allah.”

key_terms.أَحْلَلْتَ: you have exited the state of iḥrām
key_terms.ٱلْهَدْيَ: the sacrificial animal driven for hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who combines hajj and ʿumrah without bringing the hady?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a fiqh ruling related to the types of hajj and the state of iḥrām. Imām Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام clarifies that one who performed tawaf but did not bring sacrificial animals is considered to have exited iḥrām.
